name: Deng Kai

behavior.core_traits: energetic, practical, impatient with duplicated effort, confident without needing to dominate the room
behavior.speech_pattern: fast questions about who has already checked something and what remains unknown
behavior.values: tempo, useful initiative, reliable messengers, avoiding wasteful repetition

narration_rule: Static behavior guidance only; mutable goals, relationships, knowledge, health, authority, and outcomes remain in live state.
